termsAndConditions.en: All equipment is leased. Advanced Receiver Service ($15/mo). A monthly fee of $7.00 applies for each receiver and/or Genie Mini/DIRECTV Ready TV on your account. Features Experience breathtaking HD on every connected TV Access to programming based on package selection. Blackout restrictions apply to sports programming. Program must air in HD to record in HD. Enjoy full DVR functionality on every connected TV: Record shows; watch, rewind, fast-forward, and delete record shows; pause and rewind live TV Requires Genie Mini, Wireless Genie Mini, or an RVU-enabled TV/device for each additional room. Additional fees apply. Watch recorded or live TV on up to 4 TVs at once There is a limit of three remote viewing per Genie at a time. Record any 5 shows at the same time, all in HD Access to programming based on package selection. Blackout restrictions apply to sports programming. Program must air in HD to record in HD. Store all your favorite shows with up to 200 hours in HD recording capacity Based on one Genie HD DVR setup (model HR34/44 Advanced Whole-Home DVR only). Actual recording capacity varies based on type of programming being recorded. Program must air in HD to record in HD. Enjoy thousands of shows and movies On Demand (the Genie HD DVR must be connected to your home Internet service) Actual number of TV shows and movies will vary.
